# Acknowledgement

Heartfelt gratitude to Jack Lamb and Kelly Tucker for providing a functional code architecture that enabled this to be developed.

# Brief overview

In the field, the start time of each chamber enclosure is recorded. Chambers are placed on for 4 minutes. This code removes the first and last minute of chamber enclosures to ensure that the change in concentration is not subject to disturbance. After which, the data points are annotated to the respective plots and individual slopes (ΔC/ΔT) are computed. All linear regressions were inspected to have R2>0.85 (linearity test) and value greater than 1.83*10-4 mg/L/hr (detection test) for the slope to be accepted. ΔC/ΔT is then computed with chamber parameters including area, volume, and temperature to determine flux for downstream applications and analyses.

# Entering known parameters of the chamber and set up

```{r}
# volume here expressed at cm3, area in cm2 and height in cm
LiCor_internal_vol <- 20
Chamber_lid_height <- 7.62
Chamber_area <- pi*14.75*14.75
```

# Field metadata

```{r}
field <- read_excel("../Field_Data/Field_Data.xlsx", sheet = 1)
str(field)

#chamber volume in cm3 is length multiplied by area. 
#Length is given by (sum of chamber lid)+(headspace)+(extension lenght) 
#Note that headspace can be negative because floodwater may be above the top of the chamber collar
#We also convert volume from cm3 to L in the calculation below 

field$Closure_datetime_start <- as.POSIXct(
  paste(field$Date, format(as.POSIXct(field$Closure_start_time, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "%H:%M:%S")),
  format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
)

#Create Closure_datetime_end by adding Duration_min (in minutes) to Closure_datetime
#now we have the time that the chamber is enclosured by the Li-Cor Instrument
#Duration_min * 60 converts minutes to seconds (because POSIXct handles times in seconds).
field$Closure_datetime_end <- field$Closure_datetime_start + field$Duration_min * 60

field$mean_headspace <- rowMeans(field[, c("Headspace_1_cm", "Headspace_2_cm", "Headspace_3_cm", "Headspace_4_cm")], na.rm = TRUE)
field$Length_cm <- field$mean_headspace+Chamber_lid_height+(field$Extension_length_ft*30.48)
field$Volume_L <- (field$Length_cm*Chamber_area+LiCor_internal_vol)*0.001
```

#remove the first and last segments of the chamber enclosure to get stable fluxes. 
field <- field %>%
  mutate(
    trimmed_start = case_when(
      Duration_min > 4 ~ Closure_datetime_start + (Duration_min * 60 - 120) / 2,
      Duration_min == 4 ~ Closure_datetime_start + 60,
      Duration_min < 4 ~ Closure_datetime_start + (Duration_min * 60) / 6
    ),
    trimmed_end = case_when(
      Duration_min > 4 ~ Closure_datetime_end - (Duration_min * 60 - 120) / 2,
      Duration_min == 4 ~ Closure_datetime_end - 60,
      Duration_min < 4 ~ Closure_datetime_end - (Duration_min * 60) / 6
    )
  )

raw7810 <- read_tsv("../Raw_Licor_Output_By_Day/TG10-01532-2025-05-31T090000_Until_24Sep2025_all_season_here.data",
                    skip = 5   # skips the first 5 rows

needed_data <- data.frame(
  CH4 = as.numeric(raw7810$CH4)*0.001,
  datetime = as.POSIXct(
    paste(raw7810$DATE, raw7810$TIME),  # Combine date and time strings

  ),

)

needed_data <- needed_data %>%
  filter(residuals < 0.025) %>% #removes datapoints where residuals are high
  filter(!is.nan(CH4))  %>% #remove data points where CH4 was not measured
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    time = format(datetime, "%H:%M:%S")
  ) %>%
  select(CH4, date, time, datetime)

# Select points that show linear increase in (ppm/s)

```{r}
select_linear_increase <- function(df) {

  # Not enough data
  if (nrow(df) < 60) return(df %>% dplyr::slice(0))

  # Normalize time so slopes don't collapse to zero
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      datetime_num = as.numeric(datetime) -
        min(as.numeric(datetime), na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  # ---- Trim 1 minute on both ends ----
  start_trim <- min(df$datetime, na.rm = TRUE) + 80
  end_trim   <- max(df$datetime, na.rm = TRUE) - 20

  trimmed <- df %>% 
    dplyr::filter(datetime >= start_trim,
                  datetime <= end_trim)

  # ---- R2 of trimmed section ----
  if (nrow(trimmed) >= 60) {
    model_trim <- tryCatch(lm(CH4 ~ datetime_num, data = trimmed),
                           error = function(e) NULL)

    if (!is.null(model_trim)) {
      r2_trim <- summary(model_trim)$r.squared
      if (r2_trim >= 0.99) return(trimmed)
    }
  }

  # ---- Sliding 60-point window on untrimmed ----
  n <- nrow(df)
  best_r2 <- -Inf
  best_df <- NULL

  for (i in 1:(n - 59)) {
    chunk <- df[i:(i + 59), ]

    mdl <- tryCatch(lm(CH4 ~ datetime_num, data = chunk),
                    error = function(e) NULL)

    if (is.null(mdl)) next

    r2_val <- summary(mdl)$r.squared

    if (r2_val > best_r2) {
      best_r2 <- r2_val
      best_df <- chunk
    }

    if (r2_val >= 0.99) break
  }

  if (!is.null(best_df) && best_r2 >= 0.99) {
    return(best_df)
  }

  # No good window → return empty
  df %>% dplyr::slice(0)
}

get_all_linear_increases <- function(data) {

  data %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(datetime)) %>%
    group_by(Plot, date) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    map_dfr(~ select_linear_increase(.x))
}

licor_annotated <- get_all_linear_increases(licor_annotated)

```




# Flux calculation

## Function that calculates change in CH4 concentration over time (ppm/s)

```{r}
get_CH4_slopes <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(datetime),
      datetime_num = as.numeric(datetime) - min(as.numeric(datetime), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Plot, date) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    map_dfr(function(df) {
      if (nrow(df) < 2 || all(is.na(df$CH4))) {
        return(tibble(
          Plot = df$Plot[1],
          date = df$date[1],
          #n = nrow(df),
          #n_ch4 = sum(!is.na(df$CH4)),
          time_span = as.numeric(difftime(max(df$datetime), min(df$datetime), units = "secs")),
          #ch4_var = var(df$CH4, na.rm = TRUE),
          slope = NA_real_,
          r_squared = NA_real_
        ))
      }
      
      model <- tryCatch(lm(CH4 ~ datetime_num, data = df), error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (is.null(model)) {
        slope <- NA_real_
        r2 <- NA_real_
      } else {
        slope <- coef(model)["datetime_num"]
        r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
      }
      
      tibble(
        Plot = df$Plot[1],
        date = df$date[1],
        #n = nrow(df),
        #n_ch4 = sum(!is.na(df$CH4)),
        time_span = as.numeric(difftime(max(df$datetime), min(df$datetime), units = "secs")),
        #ch4_var = var(df$CH4, na.rm = TRUE),
        slope = slope,
        r_squared = r2
      )
    })
}

```

# Updated function trial

```{r}
get_CH4_slopes <- function(data, threshold = 0) {
  
  # STORAGE for rows used in slope calculations
  slope_determining_points <- list()
  idx <- 1
  
  results <- data %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(datetime),
      datetime_num = as.numeric(datetime) - min(as.numeric(datetime), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Plot, date) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    map_dfr(function(df) {
      
      Plot <- unique(df$Plot)
      date <- unique(df$date)
      
      # ----- STEP 1: Trim first/last minute -----
      t_min <- min(df$datetime)
      t_max <- max(df$datetime)
      
      df_trim <- df %>%
        filter(datetime >= (t_min + 60),   # +1 minute
               datetime <= (t_max - 60))   # -1 minute
      
      # If trimming removed everything, fallback to full df
      if(nrow(df_trim) < 2) df_trim <- df
      
      
      # ----- STEP 2: First attempt using trimmed interval -----
      attempt_fit <- function(dfx) {
        if(nrow(dfx) < 2) return(NULL)
        tryCatch(lm(CH4 ~ datetime_num, data = dfx), error = \(e) NULL)
      }
      
      model1 <- attempt_fit(df_trim)
      r2_1 <- if (!is.null(model1)) summary(model1)$r.squared else 0
      
      
      # ----- STEP 3: If R² < 0.99 → sliding window -----
      if (is.null(model1) || r2_1 < 0.99) {
        
        df_ordered <- df %>% arrange(datetime)
        n <- nrow(df_ordered)
        
        best_model <- NULL
        best_df <- NULL
        
        if (n >= 60) {
          for (i in 1:(n - 59)) {
            window_df <- df_ordered[i:(i + 59), ]
            model_w <- attempt_fit(window_df)
            
            if (!is.null(model_w)) {
              r2_w <- summary(model_w)$r.squared
              if (r2_w >= 0.99) {
                best_model <- model_w
                best_df <- window_df
                break
              }
            }
          }
        }
        
        # Use fallback if no good window found
        if (!is.null(best_model)) {
          model_use <- best_model
          df_use <- best_df
        } else {
          model_use <- model1
          df_use <- df_trim
        }
        
      } else {
        model_use <- model1
        df_use <- df_trim
      }
      
      
      # ----- STEP 4: Extract slope and R² -----
      if (is.null(model_use)) {
        slope <- NA_real_
        r2 <- NA_real_
        time_span <- NA_real_
      } else {
        slope <- coef(model_use)[["datetime_num"]]
        r2 <- summary(model_use)$r.squared
        time_span <- as.numeric(max(df_use$datetime) - min(df_use$datetime), units = "secs")
      }
      
      # ----- STEP 5: Apply slope threshold -----
      if (!is.na(slope) && slope < threshold) slope <- 0
      
      # ----- STEP 6: Store rows used -----
      df_use$Plot <- Plot
      df_use$date <- date
      slope_determining_points[[idx]] <- df_use
      idx <<- idx + 1
      
      # Output summary row
      tibble(
        Plot = Plot,
        date = date,
        slope = slope,
        r_squared = r2,
        time_span = time_span
      )
      
    })
  
  # Bind slope-determining rows
  slope_determining_points_df <- bind_rows(slope_determining_points)
  
  return(list(
    results = results,
    slope_determining_points = slope_determining_points_df
  ))
}
```

This fits finds the slopes (change in ppm over time). If R2 is less than 0.99, it activates a moving window to search for a continuous linear segment that is larger than 60s. 

For extremely small slope values (less than 0.000183mg/L/hr), the slope is set to 0 (i.e. no flux).

```{r}
get_CH4_slopes_2 <- function(data) {
  # slope threshold
  slope_threshold <- 24*(0.000183/(63*60))/0.016043
  
  data %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(datetime),
      datetime_num = as.numeric(datetime) - min(as.numeric(datetime), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Plot, date) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    map_dfr(function(df) {
      
      df <- df %>% arrange(datetime_num)
      n <- nrow(df)
      
      # Not enough data to evaluate anything
      if (n < 2 || all(is.na(df$CH4))) {
        return(tibble(
          Plot = df$Plot[1],
          date = df$date[1],
          time_span = as.numeric(difftime(max(df$datetime), min(df$datetime), units = "secs")),
          slope = 0,
          r_squared = NA_real_
        ))
      }

      # --- (A) FULL-SPAN REGRESSION ---
      model_full <- tryCatch(lm(CH4 ~ datetime_num, data = df), error = function(e) NULL)

      if (!is.null(model_full)) {
        slope_full <- coef(model_full)["datetime_num"]
        r2_full <- summary(model_full)$r.squared
      } else {
        slope_full <- NA_real_
        r2_full <- NA_real_
      }

      # If full-span R2 ≥ 0.99 → use it
      if (!is.na(r2_full) && r2_full >= 0.99) {

        # apply slope threshold rule
        if (!is.na(slope_full) && slope_full <= slope_threshold)
          slope_full <- 0

        return(tibble(
          Plot = df$Plot[1],
          date = df$date[1],
          time_span = as.numeric(difftime(max(df$datetime), min(df$datetime), units = "secs")),
          slope = slope_full,
          r_squared = r2_full
        ))
      }

      # --- (B) R2 < 0.99 → USE MOVING WINDOW OF 60 POINTS ---
      if (n < 60) {
        # not enough data for window
        return(tibble(
          Plot = df$Plot[1],
          date = df$date[1],
          time_span = as.numeric(difftime(max(df$datetime), min(df$datetime), units = "secs")),
          slope = 0,
          r_squared = NA_real_
        ))
      }

      best_r2 <- -Inf
      best_slope <- 0  # default now is 0

      window_size <- 60

      for (start in 1:(n - window_size + 1)) {
        end <- start + window_size - 1
        window <- df[start:end, ]

        mod <- tryCatch(lm(CH4 ~ datetime_num, data = window),
                        error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(mod)) next

        r2 <- summary(mod)$r.squared

        if (r2 > best_r2) {
          best_r2 <- r2
          best_slope <- coef(mod)["datetime_num"]
        }
      }

      # if best window R2 still < 0.99 → slope = 0
      if (best_r2 < 0.99) {
        best_slope <- 0
      }

      # apply slope threshold rule
      if (!is.na(best_slope) && best_slope <= slope_threshold) {
        best_slope <- 0
      }

      tibble(
        Plot = df$Plot[1],
        date = df$date[1],
        time_span = as.numeric(difftime(max(df$datetime), min(df$datetime), units = "secs")),
        slope = best_slope,
        r_squared = ifelse(best_r2 < 0.99, NA_real_, best_r2)
      )
    })
}


```

# Calculate flux 

## Going from change in concentration to flux

![Equation for calcualting flux](../Scripts/Flux_Equation.png)

Zhang, Z., Fenster, T. L. D., & Linquist, B. A. (2025). Greenhouse gas emissions altered by the introduction of a year-long fallow to continuous rice systems. Journal of Environmental Quality, 1–15. https://doi.org/10.1002/jeq2.70055

```{r}

#get temperature,volume, and chamber area from field metadata
all_fluxes$Date <- all_fluxes$date

all_fluxes <- all_fluxes %>%
  left_join(field %>% select(Date, Plot, Volume_L, Chamber_Temp_C), 
            by = c("Date", "Plot")) %>%
  mutate(Area=Chamber_area/100000000) #changing from cm2 to ha


# this is to convert change in concentration over time from ppm/s (all_fluxes$slope) to mg L-1 s-1 using ideal gas law
all_fluxes$slope_mg_L_s <- (((all_fluxes$slope)/((((760*22.4)*(273+all_fluxes$Chamber_Temp_C))/(760*273))))*(0.016043))

# get flux with chamber volume and area. Scale from mg/s to mg/d
all_fluxes$CH4_flux_g_ha_day <- ((all_fluxes$slope_mg_L_s)/(all_fluxes$Area))*(all_fluxes$Volume_L)*86400*0.001

all_fluxes$CH4_flux_g_ha_day_all_in_one <- ((((all_fluxes$slope)/((((760*22.4)*(273+all_fluxes$Chamber_Temp_C))/(760*273))))*(0.016043))/(all_fluxes$Area))*(all_fluxes$Volume_L)*86400*0.001
                              
```

## Graph where annotated and non-annotated data are both present

```{r}
# Create Date column in both datasets
licor_annotated <- licor_annotated %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(datetime))

# 1. Create buffered_time_range from field
buffered_time_range <- field %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Closure_datetime_start)) %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(
    earliest = min(Closure_datetime_start) - minutes(3),
    latest = max(Closure_datetime_end) + minutes(3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Add Date to needed_data
needed_data <- needed_data %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(datetime))

# 3. Join and filter within buffered ranges
filtered_needed_data <- needed_data %>%
  left_join(buffered_time_range, by = "Date") %>%
  filter(datetime >= earliest & datetime <= latest)

# Get shared list of dates
dates <- sort(unique(licor_annotated$Date))

# Open PDF device (side-by-side comparison, 2 per page)
pdf("../Figures/CH4_annotated_vs_unannotated.pdf", width = 11, height = 8.5)

for (i in seq(1, length(dates), by = 2)) {
  
  current_dates <- dates[i:min(i+1, length(dates))]
  
  # Subset annotated & unannotated
  annotated_sub <- licor_annotated %>% filter(Date %in% current_dates)
  unannotated_sub <- filtered_needed_data %>% filter(Date %in% current_dates)
  
  # Build plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Unannotated first (background, grey lines)
    geom_line(data = unannotated_sub, aes(x = datetime, y = CH4), color = "grey60", alpha = 0.6) +
    # Annotated overlay (colored by Plot)
    geom_point(data = annotated_sub, aes(x = datetime, y = CH4, color = Plot), size = 0.6) +
    geom_line(data = annotated_sub, aes(x = datetime, y = CH4, color = Plot), size = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ Date, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = "CH₄ concentration over time (Annotated vs. Raw)",
         x = "Time",
         y = "CH₄ (ppm)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  print(p)
}

dev.off()

```
